description: Start the OAuth flow for an Instagram account. Returns an authorization_url the user must open in a browser to complete the connection. There are two routes and they differ in what the account can do afterwards: `instagram` signs in with Instagram and needs no Facebook Page, while `facebook` signs in with Facebook, connects the Instagram professional accounts linked to the Pages the user shares, and is the only route where chirpie_delete_post can remove a published Instagram post. One Facebook grant can connect several accounts at once; any beyond the plan's account limit are stored switched off rather than dropped. Coming soon.

reconnect.description: Set when the user has been through this consent screen before, so anything they turned down last time is asked again.

via.description: Which route to use. 'instagram' (the default) needs no Facebook Page. 'facebook' requires the Instagram professional account to be linked to a Facebook Page, and is the only route where a published post can be deleted.

name: chirpie_connect_instagram
title: Connect an Instagram account
